rules.intent: Color must come from theme tokens — no raw hex/rgb/hsl literals in UI files.
rules.rationale: Single source of truth for theme; enables dark mode and audience-specific theming.

rules.intent: Font size must come from the type-scale roles — no off-scale text utilities or size literals (e.g. text-sm, text-[0.8125rem]) in UI files.
rules.rationale: The typographic mirror of no-raw-color: one shared role set consumed by name keeps the scale the single source and the vertical rhythm uniform.

rules.intent: User-facing strings must be i18n keys, not string literals.
rules.rationale: Locale audience requires every user-facing string to be translatable.

rules.intent: Features may not import another feature's internals — only its public barrel.
Overlay shells (backdrop + focus-trap + dismiss — Sheet/Dialog/Popover/Drawer) live in the base dir and are imported from its barrel; none are hand-rolled outside it.
rules.rationale: Base primitives are system foundation, created once and imported everywhere; re-implementing an overlay shell in a feature file forks the focus-trap/dismiss/portal contract and drifts the design.
